Roof Plumbing & Re-Roofing in Cranbourne North

Sandhurst Roofing is a family owned roofing business with more than 30 years of experience looking after homes right across Cranbourne North. From re-roofs in COLORBOND® steel and roof plumbing to guttering and tile to tin conversions, we back every job with honest advice and quality workmanship.

Cranbourne North has grown quickly, and we look after everything from the first-generation estate roofs through to the older homes around the township. Call Steve on 0448 812 800 for a free, no-obligation quote.

Get a Free Quote!

Roofs in Cranbourne North: What We Commonly See

Cranbourne North sits between the established township and the Lynbrook and Hampton Park side of Casey, and its housing reflects that. There is a good mix of established brick-veneer homes and newer estate housing in COLORBOND® steel. Well inland, these roofs deal with harsh UV, heat and the south-east's hailstorms rather than salt.

The jobs we are called out for most in Cranbourne North are refixing cracked ridge capping, storm and hail damage, replacing tired guttering, and re-sheeting metal roofs.

Re-Roofing & Roof Replacement in Cranbourne North

Estate roofs are now old enough that a number of Cranbourne North homes are due for a proper look. We re-roof and re-sheet homes in COLORBOND® steel, which is light, durable and suited to the south-east's hail and UV, and we can match the colour to your existing gutters and trims.

If you are thinking about going metal, our tile to tin service is a popular way to lose the weight and the upkeep. If you are unsure whether you need a full re-roof, we will inspect the roof, show you what we find and give you an honest recommendation.

Roof Plumbing & Guttering in Cranbourne North

Newer roofs still need a roof plumber now and then. Our registered roof plumbers reseal and refix flashings, valleys and ridge capping, and sort out undersized downpipes and overflowing gutters, which are the most common problems on estate homes after heavy rain or a storm.

We replace guttering, downpipes and fascia capping in COLORBOND® steel, from a single damaged section through to a complete gutter replacement, and we carry out gutter repairs where a repair is all that is needed. We remove the old guttering cleanly and leave the site tidy.

What Affects the Cost of Roofing in Cranbourne North

There is no standard price for a roof, because no two roofs are the same. The size and pitch of the roof, the profile and colour of the steel, the amount of guttering, flashings and downpipes, and the access to the site all affect the quote. We inspect the roof, put the price in writing and explain every line.

Our Cranbourne North Roofing Process

We start with a free on-site inspection and a written quote. For a re-roof we strip the old roof, prepare the framing, fit insulation and sarking where needed, then re-sheet in new COLORBOND® steel with fresh flashings, ridge capping, gutters and downpipes. We leave the site clean and tidy when we are done.

Why Cranbourne North Locals Choose Sandhurst Roofing

We are fully licensed and insured, with registered roof plumbers on the team, so your job is done to standard and you are covered. As a local, family run business we treat your home the way we would treat our own, turn up when we say we will, and give honest advice rather than a hard sell. Cranbourne North Roofing FAQs

My roof is fairly new. Do I still need a roof plumber?

Possibly. Newer roofs can still have poorly sealed flashings, undersized downpipes or storm damage. We can inspect the roof, reseal or refix what needs it and give you an honest opinion.

Can you fix hail and storm damage?

Yes. We fix dented sheeting, damaged flashings and storm-related leaks, and can advise whether a re-roof is the better option after major damage.

Do you offer free quotes?

Yes, every quote is free and without obligation. Call Steve on 0448 812 800.
